reports.title: Mailbox almost full
reports.message: Your mailbox storage is 98% full. Sign in at [link omitted] within 48 hours to keep receiving email, or new messages will be deleted.
reports.context: Our school IT team usually emails from the school's own address. This one came from a different address.
reports.subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Mailbox quota exceeded

reports.title: Skin trade that needs your login
reports.message: I'll give you 10,000 coins for your Dragon Blade skin. Just log in at [link omitted] so the trade site can verify both accounts. Quick before I change my mind!
reports.context: I have a rare Dragon Blade skin. I have never traded with this player.

reports.title: "Is this you in this video?"
reports.message: omg is this you in this video?? [link omitted]
reports.context: Jamie and I haven't talked in months. Jamie never sends links without saying something first.

reports.title: Invitation to an esports cup
reports.message: You're invited to the Asia Junior Esports Cup! Register your team by entering your game login and password at [link omitted]. Registration closes tonight at midnight.
reports.context: Our team has never applied to this cup.

reports.title: Caller asks for the code sent to my phone
reports.message: Hi, this is Mr Tan from the school office. I'm locked out of the parents' portal for your class. A code was just sent to your phone; can you read it out to me so I can get back in?
reports.context: A code arrived by text during the call. I don't know a Mr Tan in the office.
reports.channel: Phone call (written down by the reporter)
reports.sender: Caller said he was "Mr Tan from the school office"

reports.title: New sign-in alert asks for password
reports.message: Security alert: a new device in another country signed in to your account. If this wasn't you, reply to this email with your password so we can lock the account.
reports.context: I was asleep at that time and didn't sign in anywhere.

reports.title: Aunt asks for gift cards
reports.message: Hi it's your aunt, I lost my phone so I'm using a friend's. Can you buy two $50 gift cards and send me the codes? It's urgent, I'll pay you back tomorrow.
reports.context: My aunt lives overseas. I have her real number saved in my phone.

reports.title: Parcel waiting, track it here
reports.message: Your parcel is waiting for delivery. Confirm your address here: [link omitted]
reports.context: I am not expecting a parcel.

reports.title: "Official support" threatens a ban
reports.message: This is the official Galaxy Racers support team. You broke rule 4.2. Appeal within 2 hours at [link omitted] or your account will be permanently banned.
reports.context: I haven't broken any rules that I know of. The game's real support team uses a verified badge; this account has none.

reports.title: Science fair forms due Friday
reports.message: Reminder: science fair forms are due this Friday. Submit them through the usual class portal, the same way as last term. Ask me in class if you have questions.
reports.context: Mr Lee is our science teacher and usually posts reminders in this chat.
